tagline: Bounties posted. Rubies ready. Pick your contract and pay your due.

faq.a: Pick a ruby package below, add it to your basket, and check out with your Minecraft username. Rubies are delivered automatically.

faq.q: When do I get my purchase?
faq.a: Rubies are granted in-game within a minute of your payment confirming. You'll need to be online to receive them.

faq.q: I have a problem with my order. What do I do?
faq.a: Reach out on Discord with your order details and we'll sort it out.
